research_question: Identify foundational theories that may explain governance as a dynamic system rather than a static organizational function.

sources.title: Cybernetics: Or Control and Communication in the Animal and the Machine
sources.relevance_summary: Foundational treatment of feedback, control, communication, and dynamic regulation.
sourced_claims: Cybernetics studies control and communication in animals and machines.
inferences: Feedback concepts may provide a theoretical basis for modeling governance state change.

sources.title: Brain of the Firm
sources.relevance_summary: Develops the Viable System Model and treats organizations as adaptive systems requiring regulation and feedback.
sourced_claims: Beer applies cybernetic principles to organizational viability.
inferences: Organizational viability may help explain governance adaptation under changing environmental conditions.
